stem: [洗钱和恐怖融资的风险及方法]在完成豪华房地产购买时,以下哪两项属于教材直接列出的洗钱警示信号？(选择两项.)

options.A: 使用所有权透明且具有合理商业目的的公司或信托购买.
options.B: 以不相关的第三方名义购买.
options.C: 在银行融资通常存在的地区,使用出售前一套房产或变现投资的所得进行全现金购房
options.D: 使用法人实体和中介机构,且已公开披露并合理解释其合法隐私安排.
options.E: 利用以现金或定期存款单作担保的贷款.

stem_en: When completing a luxury real estate purchase, which two situations are direct real estate money laundering red flags in the material? (Select Two.)

options_en.A: Using a company or trust with transparent ownership and a legitimate business purpose to make the purchase.
options_en.B: In the names of unrelated third parties.
options_en.C: In a region where bank financing is the norm, using proceeds from a prior property sale or liquidated investments to make an all-cash purchase.
options_en.D: Using legal entities and intermediaries with transparent disclosure and a reasonable explanation for a legitimate privacy arrangement.
options_en.E: Using loans backed by cash or certificates of deposit.
